name: Raining Cats and Dogs
detailed_description:
Welcome to Raining Cats and Dogs — the only game where the weather forecast is 100% feline and canine. It's quite literally Raining Cats and Dogs. This game is a part of a video game series where YouTuber "JustJeff" grabs idioms and turns them into literal games. This game is similar to his other games "Break a Leg" and "Beat Around the Bush" where all you do is break a leg or beat around the bush. In this one? It's literally raining cats and dogs.

In this chaotic, physics-based comedy game, the sky doesn’t just fall — it meows and barks. 

In Raining cats and dogs, your goal is to reach the end and make it stop raining cats and dogs. There's a light switch at the end of the game that you can turn off so the cats and dogs can stop dying. Your goal is to platform across the landscape and climb as high as you can without being knocked off by a random cat or dog. If the cat or dog hits you, you get damaged and have force added to your character, flinging you in any direction. 

But the real madness? The top YouTube Shorts comments from JustJeff's YouTube are actually added game. This adds for some whacky gameplay features, for example - a crocodile falls out of the sky and talks to you about biscuits and tea, and all of the good and bad things about them.

The platforming is simple, just move your character using typical movement keys to jump, crouch, run and dash through the landscape. This game also has platforms that disappear, if you don't jump in time or miss your jumps, you can fall all the way back down to the beginning. Some would call this a "Foddian" Game. Don't ragequit though! Cats and dogs are dying at least once a second!

So what do you do in a game where the heavens open up and domestic pets come out like fluffy meteors? Nothing. All you can do is avoid them. In sections, there's wind in the game heavily pushing you backwards, making it even harder to platform across the landscape.

There's also floating islands that you can climb. Get as high as you can, above the clouds, and achieve victory by beating an incredibly difficult and frustrating game about raining cats and dogs. 

Play this game today and see if you really enjoy it when cats and dogs fall from the sky. If you do, you've probably got something to get checked out because these animals die in this game. Please make it stop!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 470 with 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 with 6-8 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
